claims.statement: Email-type reference declares FPT/GHEC only. Activity email categories and subscription choices do not establish GHES behavior or guaranteed delivery.

Notification options include admin security activity,watched repository activity,participating/mentioned conversations,participating PR pushes,collaboration invitations and own issue/PR actions. Category descriptions do not prove full entity/event coverage, current permission or accepted response.

Users can choose some/all activity notifications and conversation update types; this reference does not define mandatory security/account notification override or unsubscribability. Missing rule remains unspecified, not inferred required or disableable.
Paid product/feature billing receipts route to primary account email. Routing description is not authority to inspect invoices,modify billing or disclose financial records.
Customer research surveys/interviews/usability/prototypes are occasional optional participation with optional panel enrollment; example opportunities are not adopted workflow or permission to enroll.

Marketing shared fragment lists account tips,customized projects/new-feature information and subscribed newsletters; informational category not requirement to subscribe, unsubscribe or install filtering.
Detailed configuration/marketing/research references remain separately reviewed scope. No primary address,notification settings,research enrollment,billing or mail state changed.
